changePasswordPage.title: Change Password

fundPasswordPage.title: Fund password
fundPasswordPage.subtitle: An extra password used for withdrawals, internal transfers, and other sensitive fund moves—separate from your login password.
fundPasswordPage.privacyWarning: Keep this password private. Anyone with your login and fund password could move assets from your account if they bypass other protections.
fundPasswordPage.mustDifferLogin: Must be different from your login password.
fundPasswordPage.requirementsNotMet: Your new fund password does not meet the requirements.
fundPasswordPage.confirmNoMatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
fundPasswordPage.sameAsLogin: Fund password must be different from your login password.
fundPasswordPage.loadFailed: Could not load fund password status

twoFactorPage.heading: Authenticator app (TOTP)
twoFactorPage.subheading: Use Google Authenticator or any compatible app for time-based codes.
twoFactorPage.enableIntro: Add a second layer of security. You will need your authenticator app when signing in and for sensitive actions.
twoFactorPage.scanInstructions: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the secret key manually.
twoFactorPage.backupBody: Store a copy in a safe place. If you lose your phone, you will need this secret to recover access. We cannot show it again after you finish setup.
twoFactorPage.successBody: Your account is now protected with an authenticator app. Keep your backup codes or secret in a safe place.
twoFactorPage.disableIntro: Turning off 2FA reduces account security. You will need your password and a valid app code to confirm.
twoFactorPage.disableFormIntro: Enter your account password and a 6-digit code from your app.

withdrawalLimitsPage.title: Manage Crypto Withdrawal Limits
withdrawalLimitsPage.changeNotice: Adjusting the withdrawal limit will not impact any withdrawal requests that are currently being processed.
withdrawalLimitsPage.dailyTooltip: Maximum amount you can withdraw in 24 hours. Higher limits may require additional verification.
withdrawalLimitsPage.monthlyTooltip: Maximum amount you can withdraw per calendar month. Resets at the start of each month.
withdrawalLimitsPage.vipNote: The withdrawal limits associated with the VIP level will only be valid after completing Identity Verification at Lv. 1 or above.

passkeysPage.title: Passkeys
passkeysPage.subtitle: Please add a passkey for faster and more secure account protection.
passkeysPage.countBanner: You have created {count} passkey(s) (up to 10 can be set).
passkeysPage.benefit1Body: With a passkey, you can log in using fingerprint or face recognition.
passkeysPage.benefit2Body: Passkeys will automatically be available on all your synced devices.
passkeysPage.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete the passkey?
passkeysPage.deleteNoteBody: For account security, please be aware that after deleting your passkey, on-chain withdrawals, internal transfers, fiat withdrawals, Card transactions, P2P Trading, and advertising will be suspended for 24 hours.
